teams.detail: No game until the Apple Cup opener vs. Washington State, now moved to Sunday, Sept. 6 (1 p.m. PT, NBC). Jedd Fisch's staff added a 4-star cornerback, its highest-rated 2026 commitment, along with Censere Gaylord, as it builds toward year two in Seattle.

Forward Hannes Steinbach was taken 14th overall by the Charlotte Hornets in the 2026 NBA Draft. Danny Sprinkle's staff is rebuilding around a heavy international pipeline after landing Croatian forward Boris Tisma, with Jasir Rencher looking healthy - shooting, driving and lifting - in offseason workouts.

Fresh off their Super Bowl LX title, the Seahawks open training camp July 25 in Renton with nine public practices and an HBO Hard Knocks feature this fall. RB Zach Charbonnet is progressing well in his ACL rehab ahead of a late-July checkup, and the club's $9.6B sale to a Khosla-led group now awaits ratification from at least 24 of the other 31 owners.

Fresh off a 60-22, No. 1-seed finish in the East, Detroit (1-3 in Summer League) closes out Las Vegas today against Miami (also 1-3) in the consolation finale - Detroit's last result was a 100-88 loss to Phoenix on July 15. The Pistons also agreed to a three-year, $51M deal with forward John Collins and landed Jrue Holiday in a trade with Milwaukee this offseason.
Seattle sits 2nd in the AL West behind Texas and holds a wild-card spot. The Mariners host the Giants (41-55) tonight at T-Mobile Park, first pitch 7:10 p.m. PT (10:10 p.m. ET).

headlines.headline: Texas lands No. 1-class forward Marcus Spears as Duke tops the preseason Power 44 and Kansas vaults in behind Tyran Stokes
headlines.detail: Six-foot-10 forward Marcus Spears reclassified into the 2026 class and picked Texas over Arizona, LSU and Kentucky. Kansas vaulted into early 2026-27 rankings after landing five-star forward Tyran Stokes, the top overall recruit in the class, while Duke opened Andy Katz's first Power 44 at No. 1.

headlines.headline: LeBron James tells Lakers he won't return for 2026-27 as Harden declines $42.3M Cavaliers option
headlines.detail: LeBron James has informed the Lakers he will not be back next season, opening a free-agency chase in which Cleveland and Golden State both view themselves as contenders. Cavaliers guard James Harden declined the final $42.3 million year of his contract to negotiate a new multiyear deal with Cleveland instead.

headlines.headline: Seahawks' $9.6 billion sale to Khosla-led group awaits owner vote as Saints bring back Alvin Kamara
headlines.detail: The Paul Allen Estate has agreed to sell the reigning Super Bowl champion Seahawks to a Khosla family-led group for a reported $9.612 billion, a deal that still needs ratification from at least 24 of the other 31 NFL owners. Alvin Kamara returned to New Orleans on a pay cut after the Saints signed Travis Etienne Jr.

headlines.headline: Texas adds Auburn's Cam Coleman to surround Arch Manning as the transfer portal cycle tops 3,600 players
headlines.detail: Texas landed wide receiver Cam Coleman from Auburn, who piled up 1,306 yards and 13 touchdowns over the past two seasons. The 2026 cycle has now seen 3,664 of 14,070 FBS players enter the portal, with Ohio State and Texas A&M among the other programs reshaping the sport's top tier.
